context: After school. Hina rushes to Yumiko in the kitchen with a folded paper, very pleased with herself.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お母さん、お母さん！これ見て見て！
lines.en: Mom, mom! Look at this, look look!
lines.style: Pure eight-year-old explosion. Bouncing in the voice. Paper waved on the second 「見て」.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: はいはい、なに？……うわ、すごい。
lines.en: Okay okay, what is it? …Whoa — that's great.
lines.style: Mom-tone shifts mid-line. The first half is logistical; the 「うわ」 is genuinely impressed. Genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 本当に？うさぎ、大きいでしょ？
lines.en: For real? The bunny's big, right?
lines.style: Lit-up question. Her own pride breaking through. Lift on 「大きい」 as she points.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、上手。これ、クラスで一番じゃない？
lines.en: Yeah, it's great. Best in the class, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm exaggeration but the warmth is honest. Mom-tone returning.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ありがとう！冷蔵庫に貼っていい？
lines.en: Thank you! Can I put it on the fridge?
lines.style: Already moving. The question is performative — she's already going for the magnets.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいよ。一番上のとこに貼ってあげる。
lines.en: Sure. I'll put it right at the top.
lines.style: Walking-toward-her warmth. The plan is being shared on the move.
